questions.prompt: An administrator must create ordinary cloud-only users in Microsoft Entra ID without assigning directory administrator roles. Which listed role is the least-privileged fit?

options.explanation: It supports ordinary user lifecycle administration.
It is broader than required for this task.

options.text: Contributor on an Azure resource group.
options.explanation: Azure resource management permission is not Entra user administration.
Inviting external guests is different from creating internal cloud accounts.

questions.prompt: A user's department is synchronized from on-premises Active Directory. Routine cloud edits are rejected or later overwritten. Where should the normal department update be made?

options.text: At the authoritative on-premises directory source.
options.explanation: Synchronization should carry the maintained attribute into Entra.

options.text: In a tag on the Azure subscription.
options.explanation: Resource tags do not change user directory attributes.

options.text: In the user's product license assignment.
options.explanation: Licensing does not set the authoritative department.

options.text: Create a second cloud user with the same display name.
options.explanation: A duplicate identity does not repair the existing object's source attribute.

questions.prompt: An Entra cloud user's display name changes. Which value should an existing application use to continue identifying that same directory object?

options.explanation: It identifies the object independently of a display-name edit.
Display names can change and need not be unique.
Many users can share a department.
A licensing-related location is not a unique object identifier.
